violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: trays observed not sanitized from dish machine with 0 PPM of chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC washed, rinsed, and sanitized all equipment.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed dish machine with 0 ppm of chlorine. During inspection, PIC repaired machine.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Observed chlorine in dish machine at 50 PPM prior to end of inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the 3 compartment sink is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. Observed hand sink at 3 compartment sink unable to turn on.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. Please repair hand sink. EHS will conduct a follow up inspection within 10 days.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Observed employee coffee cup stored on shelf above cleaned dishes.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC discarded coffee cup.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE CHLORINE CONCENTRATION IN THE CHEMICAL DISH MACHINE AT 0ppm.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CONTRACTOR WAS ABLE TO REPAIR THE DISH MACHINE AND THE CHLORINE CONCENTRATION WAS OBSERVED AT 50ppm.
